# Peak Hair Restoration Clinic

> Surgical and non-surgical hair loss treatments — Sapphire FUE transplants, PRP packages and stem cell therapy — delivered by surgeon-led medical teams in Istanbul, New York and Miami. Every treatment plan begins with a free, no-obligation medical assessment, not a sales pitch.

Peak Hair Restoration Clinic is a hair transplant and hair restoration clinic. All consultations and treatment plans are assessed and approved by licensed surgeons; patients speak directly with the surgeon who would perform their procedure.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.peakhairtransplant.com/): Overview of treatments, clinic locations, patient results, financing and reviews
- [FUE Hair Transplant](https://www.peakhairtransplant.com/fue): Follicular unit extraction — technique, candidacy and recovery
- [DHI Hair Transplant](https://www.peakhairtransplant.com/dhi-hair-transplant): Direct hair implantation technique explained
- [Sapphire FUE Hair Transplant NYC](https://www.peakhairtransplant.com/sapphire-fue-hair-transplant-nyc): Sapphire-blade FUE for denser packing and faster healing
- [PRP Hair Restoration](https://www.peakhairtransplant.com/prp-hair-restoration): Non-surgical platelet-rich plasma treatment packages
- [Stem Cell Hair Therapy](https://www.peakhairtransplant.com/stem-cell-hair-therapy): Regenerative, non-surgical treatment for early-stage thinning

## Locations

- [Hair Transplant New York](https://www.peakhairtransplant.com/new-york-hair-transplant): Premium Manhattan hair restoration clinic
